facts.founders_experience: Founders and leadership team have extensive backgrounds in enterprise AI, search, and large-scale systems. CEO Arvind Jain previously served as Chief Architect at Google, leading search infrastructure and AI initiatives. Other executives include former leaders from Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Uber with expertise in AI, data platforms, and enterprise software.
